DRAFT — SUBJECT TO REVIEW BY RHC AND ITS SOLICITORS. NOT FOR EXECUTION UNTIL APPROVED.

# Consultancy Services Agreement

**Date:** 9 October 2026

## PARTIES
1. **RHC City Pty Ltd** (ABN 12 345 678 901) of 1 Eagle Street, Brisbane QLD 4000 (**RHC**)
2. **Smith Planning Pty Ltd** (ABN [●]) of [● address] (**Consultant**)

## BACKGROUND
A. RHC is developing the Riverside Residences project at 22 River Road, Hamilton QLD 4007 (**Project**).
B. RHC wishes to engage the Consultant to provide town planning services for the Project on the terms of this agreement.

## 1. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATION
1.1 In this agreement, unless the context requires otherwise:
(a) **Business Day** means a day that is not a Saturday, Sunday or public holiday in Brisbane, Queensland;
(b) **Deliverables** means all documents, reports, plans and other material prepared by the Consultant in performing the Services;
(c) **Fee** means the amount set out in Item 3 of the Schedule;
(d) **GST** has the meaning given in the A New Tax System (Goods and Services Tax) Act 1999 (Cth);
(e) **Insolvency Event** means, in relation to a party, the appointment of a liquidator, administrator, receiver or similar officer, or any analogous event;
(f) **Services** means the services described in Item 2 of the Schedule.
1.2 In this agreement, headings are for convenience only and do not affect interpretation, and the singular includes the plural and vice versa.

## 2. ENGAGEMENT AND SERVICES
2.1 RHC engages the Consultant to perform the Services, and the Consultant accepts that engagement, on the terms of this agreement.
2.2 The Consultant must:
(a) perform the Services with the degree of skill, care and diligence expected of a qualified and experienced town planner;
(b) comply with all applicable laws, including the Planning Act 2016 (Qld); and
(c) comply with RHC's reasonable directions, including:
(i) attending project control group meetings when requested; and
(ii) providing written progress reports every two weeks.

## 3. FEES AND PAYMENT
3.1 In consideration of the Services, RHC must pay the Consultant the Fee in accordance with this clause 3.
3.2 The Consultant must issue a valid tax invoice at the end of each calendar month for Services properly performed in that month.
3.3 RHC must pay each undisputed invoice within 30 days after receiving it.
3.4 If GST is payable on a taxable supply made under this agreement, the recipient must pay an additional amount equal to the GST, at the same time as the consideration, on receipt of a valid tax invoice.

## 4. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY
4.1 All intellectual property rights in the Deliverables vest in RHC on creation.
4.2 The Consultant grants RHC a perpetual, irrevocable, royalty-free licence to use any pre-existing material incorporated into the Deliverables for the purposes of the Project.

## 5. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
5.1 Neither party is liable to the other for any indirect or consequential loss, including loss of profit or revenue.
5.2 The Consultant's aggregate liability under this agreement is limited to the amount recoverable under the professional indemnity insurance required by clause 6.

## 6. INSURANCE
The Consultant must maintain, for the term of this agreement and for six years after it ends:
- public liability insurance of at least $20 million per occurrence;
- professional indemnity insurance of at least $5 million per claim; and
- workers compensation insurance as required by law.

## 7. TERMINATION
7.1 RHC may terminate this agreement for convenience by giving 14 days' written notice to the Consultant.
7.2 Either party may terminate this agreement immediately by written notice if the other party:
(a) commits a material breach that is not remedied within 14 days after receiving notice of it; or
(b) suffers an Insolvency Event.

## 8. GOVERNING LAW
This agreement is governed by the laws of Queensland and each party submits to the non-exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Queensland.
